metadata.title: InvitaCon - Digital Invitations

hero.title: Digital invitations that leave a mark
hero.subtitle: Design elegant invitations for weddings, baptisms and celebrations. Customize, pay and share with a unique link.

howItWorks.title: It's that easy

choose.description: Select from our professional designs for weddings, baptisms, communions and more.

share.title: 3. Publish and share

templates.title: Templates for every occasion
